title: Nice Bag But Not For Keeping Things Cool
text: Nice Bag But Not For Keeping Things Cool. This bag is really pretty and made well. I bought it to take food on road trips. The only thing is, it is not completely insulated. The zipper does not close all the way on the top so food is not going to stay colder longer than an hour. Also, the first time I used it the zipper came apart. It was an easy fix but it still shouldn't have happened. I think I will turn it into a beach bag but still disappointed because I needed it to keep things cold.

product_metadata.title: Steel Mill & Co Cooler Tote, Insulated Cooler Bag, Soft Cooler with Secure Zip Close, Collapsible Cooler for Beach or Grocery
features: PADDED INSULATED COOLER: Portable cooler features a protective padded body with solid white insulated interior lining that keeps contents fresh for hours at a time. The slick interior is easy to clean - simply wet a cloth and wipe the mess away

EASY TO CARRY: The soft cooler features a soft canvas exterior that makes the bag comfortable to carry and easy to store away. The long strap is adjustable for a customized fit and made of a thick cotton material that is sturdy and pleasant on the shoulder

LARGE CAPACITY: Personal cooler measures 10 inches (25.4 cm) wide x 12 inches (30.5 cm) tall and has one main compartment to easily fill. Soft cooler includes an exterior pocket to store quick access items (like your car keys and cell phone). Its heavy-duty body is made to withstand countless market trips, beach days, and family gatherings

MULTIPURPOSE: Insulated tote bag has a large opening that makes it easy to load/unload and perfect for multiple uses. Whether storing drinks (it's tall enough for a wine bottle!) and snacks at the beach, or carrying home produce from the farmers market, this soft cooler will keep everything fresh

PRETTY AND PRACTICAL: Cooler tote features a colorful pineapple design with hot pink straps. Complete with an adjustable shoulder strap, exterior pocket, and an insulated interior, this tote is the perfect addition to your camping trips and pool days. Plus, you can stash wet swimsuits in it after a beach day to keep the rest of your items dry!
